card: This PR disables wide-character support, zoneinfo, generic clocale, and experimental filesystem routines in Guix cross-compiled libstdc++ for non-GUI Linux binaries, keeping wchar_t enabled only for GUI targets. It also patches Boost Test to build without std::wcrtomb. The change reduces the size of release binaries like bitcoind and bitcoin-cli by roughly 0.5 MB.
changed_since_previous: Added `--disable-libstdcxx-filesystem-ts` and `--enable-clocale=generic` to the libstdc++ build flags.
evidence: PR description benchmarks show binary size reductions of approximately 0.48 MB across non-GUI binaries: bitcoind drops from 17.75 MB to 17.27 MB, bitcoin-wallet from 9.26 MB to 8.77 MB, and bitcoin-cli from 8.20 MB to 7.72 MB.
problem: Release Linux binaries include unused C++ runtime features like wide-character support, timezone info, and experimental filesystem routines from libstdc++, inflating binary sizes by roughly half a megabyte.

risk.why: Altering libstdc++ flags in the release Guix toolchain could cause runtime crashes or missing symbols in release binaries if any non-GUI code relies on wide-character or locale features.

scope_notes: Modifies Guix Linux toolchain flags and adds a patch to depends for Boost Test.
summary: Configures the GCC cross-compiler toolchain in Guix for non-GUI Linux targets with `--disable-wchar_t`, `--enable-clocale=generic`, and `--with-libstdcxx-zoneinfo=no`, while also disabling experimental filesystem library builds. In addition, it patches Boost Test in the depends system to invoke `wcrtomb` instead of `std::wcrtomb` so unit tests compile against libstdc++ without wide-character support.
